title: 49ers re-sign S Ashtyn Davis, P Corliss Waitman, place two on IR

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers re-sign S Ashtyn Davis, P Corliss Waitman, place two on IR
sources.description: After reducing their roster to 53 players on Sunday, the 49ers have brought back a pair of veterans who were released and not subject to waivers.
